description: Monitors GitHub Copilot OpenTelemetry telemetry using Prometheus metrics and Tempo traces. Tracks agent operations, token consumption, model latency, tool calls, reliability, and trace drill-down.

panels.description: Key performance indicators for agent operations over the selected dashboard time range. Estimated total cost is the sum of github.copilot.nano_aiu span values converted to AI Credits.

targets.expr: round(sum_over_time((sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m))))[$__range:1m]))

sum_over_time((sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m))))[$__range:1m])

sum_over_time((sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m))))[$__range:1m])

sum_over_time((sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_sum{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_sum{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_sum{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_sum{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m))))[$__range:1m]) / clamp_min(sum_over_time((sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m))))[$__range:1m]), 1e-9)

panels.title: Agent Summary Statistics

panels.description: LLM calls, chat sessions, tool calls, reasoning calls, and average time to first token over the selected dashboard time range.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${source:regex}" && span.gen_ai.response.model != nil && span.copilot_chat.reasoning_content != nil } | count_over_time()

panels.title: Chat & Tool Summary

panels.description: Number of operations in each dashboard time interval, grouped by operation type.

targets.expr: round(sum by (gen_ai_operation_name) (clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval))))

panels.title: Operations Over Time

panels.description: Total token consumption (input + output) over time, broken down by model.

targets.expr: round(sum by (gen_ai_response_model) (clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval)))) > 0

panels.title: Token Consumption Over Time by Model

panels.description: Breakdown of LLM calls by model. Shows which AI models are being used and how frequently.

targets.expr: topk(7, round(sum by (gen_ai_response_model) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Model Usage Distribution

panels.description: Average and P90 response duration per response model. Helps identify which models are slower.

targets.expr: sort_desc(round(1000 * sum by (gen_ai_response_model) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_sum{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (gen_ai_response_model) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range])), 1e-9)))

round(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, gen_ai_response_model) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_bucket{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Response Duration by Model (Avg / P90)

panels.description: Time to First Token (TTFT) percentiles per response model. Uses the response-duration fallback when TTFT is not exported with response-model labels.

targets.expr: round(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, gen_ai_response_model) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_bucket{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))))

round(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, gen_ai_response_model) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_bucket{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Time to First Token by Model (P50 / P90)

panels.description: Breakdown of Copilot feature usage over the selected range. Uses operation names because the local Prometheus metrics do not expose gen_ai.agent.name.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(7, round(sum by (gen_ai_operation_name) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range])))) or label_replace((round(sum(sum by (gen_ai_operation_name) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))) - sum(topk(7, sum by (gen_ai_operation_name) (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))))) > 0), "gen_ai_operation_name", "other", "", ""))

panels.title: Copilot Feature Usage

panels.description: Top tools invoked by Copilot during agent interactions. Shows the top seven tool names over the selected range and groups the remaining tools as other.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(7, round(sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (max_over_time(github_copilot_tool_call_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range])))) or label_replace((round(sum(sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (max_over_time(github_copilot_tool_call_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))) - sum(topk(7, sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (max_over_time(github_copilot_tool_call_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__range]))))) > 0), "gen_ai_tool_name", "other", "", ""))

panels.title: Top Tool Calls

panels.description: Copilot activity over time: chat sessions, LLM calls, and tool calls counted per dashboard interval.

targets.expr: round(sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="invoke_agent", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval))))

round(sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_operation_name="chat", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval))))

round(sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(github_copilot_tool_call_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) - max_over_time(github_copilot_tool_call_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval), 0) or (max_over_time(github_copilot_tool_call_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) unless max_over_time(github_copilot_tool_call_count{job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval))))

panels.title: Sessions, Turns & Tool Calls Over Time

panels.description: Detailed breakdown of LLM calls and total input tokens per model over the selected dashboard time range.

targets.expr: round(sum by (gen_ai_response_model) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_count{gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m)))[$__range:1m])))

round(sum by (gen_ai_response_model) (sum_over_time((clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[1m] offset 1m)))[$__range:1m])))

panels.title: Token Usage by Model

panels.description: Input vs Output token ratio over time. A high ratio indicates large prompts with relatively small responses, which is typical for code context.

targets.expr: round(sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="input", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval))))

round(sum(clamp_min(max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) - max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval), 0) or (max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval]) unless max_over_time(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_token_type="output", gen_ai_response_model=~".+", job=~"${source:regex}", otel_scope_name="github.copilot"}[$__interval] offset $__interval))))

panels.title: Input vs Output Tokens Over Time

panels.description: Exceptions thrown by Copilot Chat over time. Includes canceled operations, MCP server errors, and other failures.

targets.expr: sum(rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"${source:regex}", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Exceptions Over Time

panels.description: Detailed exception log showing each error with timestamp, type, and message. Useful for debugging Copilot issues like MCP server failures or canceled requests.

targets.expr: sum by (span_name) (traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"${source:regex}", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"})

panels.title: Exception Details

panels.description: Recent GitHub Copilot invoke_agent traces from Tempo. Select a trace ID to inspect its spans; matched span details include token attributes when exported.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${source:regex}" && span.gen_ai.operation.name = "invoke_agent" && span.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens != nil && span.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens != nil } | select(span.gen_ai.operation.name, span.gen_ai.response.model, span.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, span.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) with (most_recent=true)
